tasks.short: Respond to public complaints and send the reply.

steps.what: Accept how they respond to complaints.
Send the accepted reply to public complaints.

tasks.design: The technician responds to the public suggestions and accepts how they respond to the complaints. {EMAIL} only opens the message already received, then sends the reply they accepted. Names and the complaint leave only in that version. Nothing writes the reply.
tasks.previous_blocker: A complaint already received was copied into a new note before they could answer it.
tasks.enabler_now: A complaint already in the mailbox can be opened as it arrived.
tasks.still_hard: What to say to the resident stays with the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician responds. A mailbox does not.
tasks.altitude: The response stays in full. Only opening the received complaint and sending the accepted reply are shorter.

reach.task: Receive the reply the technician accepted
reach.learn: The resident still gets the technician's words

evidence.claim: A stored activity or complaint can be listed. The technician writes the report or the reply.
Names of residents and complaint text are personal data. They leave only in a reply the technician accepted.
This design does not score technicians and does not record calls. A list of open work is not a performance record.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a public suggestion or complaint arrives and ends when the accepted reply is sent. The technician writes the reply. Names leave only in that version.

The fields are the complaint id, the suggestion text already received, and the reply they accept. The mailbox produces the complaint. The technician produces the reply. A complaint they have not read is not answered.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the response stays. The open and the send are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether complaints arrive already written, or only by telephone.
Which complaints the office will not answer until the technician has visited the place.
research_questions: Do complaints arrive already written, or only by telephone?
Which complaints will the office not answer until the technician has visited the place?

already_counted.description: The whole step stays with the civil engineering technician
The whole step stays with the civil engineering technician

incremental.description: Keep the reply to words the technician accepted

approvals.approved_version: reply the civil engineering technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If they have not accepted the reply, the send stays unused, and the low end is the response, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Negotiate contract prices and file them.

steps.what: Read prices on the existing contracts.
File the accepted prices on the contracts.

tasks.design: The technician negotiates prices with the contractors and negotiates modifications to existing contracts, then accepts the prices. {DOCS} only opens prices already on the contract, then files the prices they accepted. The file does not close the contract. Nothing negotiates.
tasks.previous_blocker: The price already on the contract was copied out before the negotiation.
tasks.enabler_now: A price the contract already states can be opened before they negotiate.
tasks.still_hard: What price the contractor will accept stays with the technician in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The technician negotiates. A filed price does not close the contract.
tasks.altitude: The negotiation stays in full. Only opening the existing price and filing the accepted price are shorter.

reach.task: Hear the price the technician accepted
reach.learn: The contractor still negotiates in the room

evidence.claim: A stated price can be shown. Which price applies is the technician's estimate.
Negotiating a price is the technician's decision. A filed price is the one they accepted. It does not close the contract.
This design does not score technicians and does not record calls. A list of open work is not a performance record.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a contract price is to be negotiated and ends when the accepted price is filed. The technician negotiates. The file does not close the contract.

The fields are contract id, the existing price, and the price they accept. The contract produces the existing price. The technician produces the accepted price. A price they did not accept is not filed.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the negotiation stays. The open and the filing are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether the existing contract already states a price they can open.
Which modifications the office will not file until both parties have signed.
research_questions: Does the existing contract already state a price they can open?
Which modifications will the office not file until both parties have signed?
